DICOM tag **(0008,0010)** was called **Recognition Code**. It was a legacy ACR-NEMA identifier used to help recognize/identify the format or protocol in older datasets.

Its status is now **retired** in the DICOM standard. It has no current defined use and should not be included in newly created DICOM objects; it may only appear in legacy data for backward compatibility.
